items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Well, I think Cattro has to be rated with the... With all the great clarinet players.

ctx.x: Well, I think Cattro has to be rated with the... With all the great clarinet players. He has to have a spot there. Because there's no doubt about it. His tonation, his improvisation, and his sense of the song that he's playing, it's all bad. And what about...
What were your exercise books that you had? Well, I had a French book that someone stole from.
